args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I like how clean and straightforward it is — it clearly communicates that it's your personal site. One suggestion: it would be great to see more content, such as a short bio, your interests, or projects you're working on, to give visitors a better sense of who you are. Adding a bit more detail and maybe some visual elements could make it even more engaging. Keep up the good work!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that you highlight your favorite hobby — hiking! It gives the blog a clear personal touch. A suggestion: consider adding some blog posts about your hiking adventures, favorite trails, or tips for fellow hikers. Including photos from your hikes would make it even more engaging. Looking forward to reading more!
